title: Candles, “witches,” anyone had a similar mallworld dream?

classification.theory_summary: Author speculates about candles representing awareness/lucid dreaming and compares three old women to the three fates (symbolic interpretation).
classification.question_topic: Asking if others have had a similar mallworld dream involving candles/three old women (“witches”).

meta.author_theory: Mentions possible link to lucid dreaming/mass awareness; compares three old women to “three fates” and describes them as oppressive/hierarchical (interpretive).

qualities.raw_description: Dreamer wakes up in a simple, small mall; stores are closed but the main lights are on; other people all around are asleep on the floor (middle school age).

locations.location_name: room the three old women are in

qualities.raw_description: A room where three old women are located; the crowd goes to confront them there.

connections.qualities: Dreamer and others gather into a crowd and go to the room the women are in.

interactions.description: Dreamer wakes up in the mall; stores are closed; main lights are on; many middle-school-aged people are asleep on the floor holding candles on dishes.

entities_involved.description: People all around, all the dreamer’s age (middle school age), asleep on the floor with candles and a dish to carry them on.

interactions.description: Dreamer’s candle is the only one lit; dreamer touches the wick of a sleeping person’s candle to ignite it, which allows them to wake up; dreamer goes around doing this for everyone.

entities_involved.description: A middle-school-aged person sleeping on the floor with an unlit candle; wakes after candle is ignited.
Multiple sleeping peers whose candles are ignited by the dreamer so they wake up.

interactions.description: Group agrees (at least from dreamer’s perspective) that they have to get rid of three old women in the mall who can extinguish candles / put them to sleep; they gather into a crowd to confront them.

entities_involved.description: Middle-school-aged crowd that the dreamer rallies to confront the women.
Three old women in the mall with the power to extinguish candles or put people to sleep forever; called “witches.”

interactions.description: Upon reaching the room, the dreamer verbally confronts the women (asking why they did it). The woman closest smiles and blows out the dreamer’s candle, which wakes the dreamer up.

entities_involved.description: One of the old women (closest to the dreamer) smiles and blows out the dreamer’s candle.
Two additional old women present with the first (three total).

extraction.extraction_notes: Spatial layout is minimal but includes a mall containing a specific room where three old women are confronted. Dream sequence is clear (wake in mall → ignite others’ candles → crowd confrontation → candle blown out → waking). Author mentions recurring mall dreams in general; the detailed narrative is a specific childhood dream from middle school.
